item_b_apple_liquid_glass_availability.official_skill_evidence: swiftui-liquid-glass SKILL.md specifically targets future iOS/Apple platforms with 'if #available(iOS 26, *)' for custom .glassEffect() and GlassEffectContainer APIs.

corrected_policy.LIQUID_GLASS_API_AVAILABILITY: Future Apple platform SDKs (iOS 26+ / visionOS); standard system toolbars and sheets adopt system materials automatically in current SDKs
corrected_policy.FALLBACK_STRATEGY: Crisp hairline borders (1px #30363D / #E8E2D8) with native system materials. Under NO circumstances will fake software blur shaders or canvas filters be written for iOS 17 or 18.

item_c_google_maps_mobile_sdk_cost.claimed_in_m0: $0 unlimited mobile map loads as a permanent architectural cost guarantee
item_c_google_maps_mobile_sdk_cost.rationale: While Google Maps SDK for Android and iOS currently offers free native mobile map loads without billing per dynamic map load, Google Maps Platform terms are subject to vendor price modifications at any time. It must be tracked as a market condition, not an immutable architectural invariant.
